Name: RGB
Desc: The "physicist's model:" the quantity of each primary colour (red, green, blue).
RGBSlice: Press SELECT to alter the colour in use.
RGBXTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
RGBXKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
RGBYTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
RGBYKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
RGBZTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour and to see a different slice.
RGBZKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour and to see a different slice.
RGBRedPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of red.
RGBGreenPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of green.
RGBBluePercent: Type a new value for the percentage of blue.
RGBRedUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the red component.
RGBRedDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the red component.
RGBGreenUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the green component.
RGBGreenDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the green component.
RGBBlueUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the blue component.
RGBBlueDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the blue component.
RGBRedSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this amount of red.
RGBGreenSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this amount of green.
RGBBlueSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this amount of blue.
